sentences.text: I could not find any in-force rule in the provided evidence that states a maximum interest rate for MSE loans offered by a UCB.

The only interest-rate publication rule in the evidence is for microfinance loans, which requires display of minimum, maximum and average interest rates, but it does not set a maximum rate for MSE loans.
The other in-force UCB provisions in the evidence address penal charges, benchmark-rate changes, and loan statements, not a cap on the interest rate for MSE business loans.
